body: world.bazaars map[slot]map[itemID]price. bazaar set <item> <price>: lists item at price. bazaar list: show own listings. bazaar list <player>: show their listings. bazaar buy <player> <item>: deducts gil from buyer, pays seller, transfers item. Seller notified on sale.
title: S99-03: MUD bazaar personal shops — bazaar set/list/buy commands
